points_of_agreement: All seats agree the rate path no longer widens against the euro.
All seats give a bounded range rather than a point forecast.
The macro and sentiment seats both put candidates before a pick.
points_of_disagreement: Macro reads the week long; positioning reads it short because the crowd is long already.
Sentiment abstains, which supports neither side.
matters_most: The positioning seat is the one that changes what to do. If the crowd is already long, the macro backdrop is priced in and the long has no marginal buyer, so the trade waits for a pullback rather than entering into the crowd.
